title: Manual total time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time for the manual lane as 40 s, including deceleration, payment, and acceleration phases.

title: Manual total distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total distance for the manual lane as 100 m, summing the deceleration and acceleration displacements.

title: ETC total time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time for the ETC lane as 12 s, including deceleration, constant speed, and acceleration phases.

title: ETC total distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total distance for the ETC lane as 85 m, summing the deceleration, constant speed, and acceleration displacements.

title: Time saved
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time saved by the ETC lane as 26.5 s, the difference between manual and ETC total times.

title: Kinematic equations application
description: Important: Applies correct kinematic equations (e.g., v = u + at, s = (u+v)t/2) to find times and displacements for acceleration/deceleration phases.

title: Constant speed segment
description: Important: Correctly identifies and calculates the time for the constant 5 m/s segment over the 10 m distance in the ETC lane.

title: Phase structure
description: Important: Clearly breaks down the problem into distinct phases (deceleration, stop/payment, acceleration for manual; deceleration, constant, acceleration for ETC).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration/deceleration, leading to wrong times or distances.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation and presents final answers with correct units.
